doc: How League numbers become Elden Ring numbers. One row per constant.

rows.why: seen in game: 0.0075 made him 1.5x the Tarnished; 0.0055 puts his ~370-unit pose at about 2 m, a head taller
League ranges feel short against Elden Ring enemies; AA 480 -> 5.8 m, E 850 -> 10.2 m

rows.unit: ability power per Elden Ring level above 1
rows.why: levelling at graces still matters: level 50 -> 196 AP, level 150 -> 596 AP
League damage against Elden Ring HP is already close (Limgrave soldier ~150 HP vs Q 40-120)

rows.unit: xp per max HP of a killed enemy
rows.why: a Limgrave soldier (~200 HP) gives 70 XP, like a League minion wave share
weak critters still count
a boss is worth about a level
without lock-on, basic attacks and Terror pick the nearest enemy in front of the camera
crow bolts visibly travel
League silences enemies in the centre of Reap
League Crowstorm ticks 4 times per second
turns League's model forward onto the Tarnished's facing; checked in game
League meshes are authored mirrored in X relative to some engines; checked in game
League's Reap slow lasts 1.25 s (tooltip); the spell data only has the silence duration
Terrify stuns (creator: no fleeing): the enemy freezes in place, no actions or movement, until it ends
League's lines are mastered far louder than Elden Ring's mix: 0.8 was much too loud in game; 0.3 -> 0.22 (creator: a bit lower)
Attack1 is 0.33 s raw (too snappy) and 0.75 of the 1.6 s period (1.2 s) felt sluggish: ~0.55 s at level 1, back to the raw clip at high attack speed
the bolt leaves his demon hand a little before the middle of the swing (FiddleSticks_BA_Cas runs frames 8-19 of 37)
League plays Melee_Attack1/2 when the target is right next to him: a claw swipe, no bolt
the Tarnished's movement slows down hard while Bountiful Harvest drains, back to normal when it ends (creator's request)
Reap's League damage (with the AP the rune level gives) one-shot the early guards; the creator found it too strong
Terrify's icon floats over a feared head
after the channel Crowstorm launches him forward (or at the locked target) like a jump (creator's request)
how far the Crowstorm jump carries him with no locked target
the arc of the jump (drawn on Fiddlesticks' model; the Tarnished's own position follows the ground)
Fiddlesticks shrugs off staggers (creator's request): the Tarnished's poise is refilled to this every frame

the poise he would really have (his Elden Ring maximum) refills after this long without being hit, like the game's own; when hits would have broken it while he drains, Bountiful Harvest is interrupted

rows.unit: renderer blend: 0 alpha, 1 add, 2 premultiplied, 3 screen, 4 multiply
rows.why: League particle blendMode 0 -> none/opaque; League does not document them, read off which textures use each

rows.unit: renderer blend: 0 alpha, 1 add, 2 premultiplied, 3 screen, 4 multiply
rows.why: League particle blendMode 1 -> alpha blend (dark smoke, crows, shadowy beams); League does not document them, read off which textures use each

rows.unit: renderer blend: 0 alpha, 1 add, 2 premultiplied, 3 screen, 4 multiply
rows.why: League particle blendMode 2 -> additive (bright sparks, flares); League does not document them, read off which textures use each

rows.unit: renderer blend: 0 alpha, 1 add, 2 premultiplied, 3 screen, 4 multiply
rows.why: League particle blendMode 3 -> unused by Fiddlesticks; additive; League does not document them, read off which textures use each

rows.unit: renderer blend: 0 alpha, 1 add, 2 premultiplied, 3 screen, 4 multiply
rows.why: League particle blendMode 4 -> additive: as premultiplied it drew opaque black squares (textures whose black is meant to vanish)

rows.unit: renderer blend: 0 alpha, 1 add, 2 premultiplied, 3 screen, 4 multiply
rows.why: League particle blendMode 5 -> screen (soft glows, rays, embers); League does not document them, read off which textures use each
League effects that fly from a drained enemy to Fiddlesticks (W heal) take this long
how fast Fiddlesticks' model turns to a new direction (higher = snappier; ~12 turns most of the way in 0.2 s) instead of snapping

Elden Ring's HUD is hidden (CSFeManImp.hud_state HideAll, set after MenuMan each frame; zeroing its values did nothing) and the mod draws enemy health bars and a boss bar itself. HideAll also hides the compass and rune count
after a boss dies, the item choice opens once every boss health bar has been gone this long (a boss's second phase keeps its bar)
a strong (team 7) enemy dying this close to a full-screen banner request (ENEMY FELLED) counts as a boss: the boss health bars are not filled while Elden Ring's HUD is hidden
